name: Ami (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ami town emblem in white: three interlaced curved strokes forming a triquetra.
history: Municipal flag of Ami, a town in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 12 March 1962.

features.role: Ami town emblem — three interlaced curved strokes forming a triquetra
